europe_now.title: Nationwide Protests and Strikes Across France
europe_now.summary: Demonstrations and strikes over living costs have seen large turnout across France, with significant participation from both public and private sector unions.

sources.headline: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
🔴 Live: Interior ministry says 600,000 protest across France as unions claim 'close to 1.6 million'

top_stories.title: EU Budget Negotiations and Corporate Policy
top_stories.summary: The European Union has looked toward large firms to help secure a final budget agreement. This financial strategy aims to resolve ongoing legislative hurdles surrounding corporate contributions.

sources.headline: EU targets large firms to unlock budget deal

top_stories.title: Post-Election Legal and Judicial Developments in Serbia
top_stories.summary: Serbia's judiciary has initiated active investigations and arrests following a significant electoral victory by the Students' List. These actions target previously stalled and unresolved legal cases in the country.
